articles.title_en: Powerful storm kills one, injures about 30 in southern Russia. See the flooded streets, toppled trees, and wrecked cars.
articles.lead_en: On July 25, a powerful storm with heavy rain and thunderstorms swept through Russia’s Rostov region. One person died in the storm, and 28 more were injured, according to the latest data cited by Rostov-on-Don Mayor Alexander Skryabin on July 26.

articles.title_en: Ukrainian drone hits apartment building in Russia. Two killed, eight injured.
articles.lead_en: A Ukrainian drone strike on Rostov-on-Don overnight on July 27 killed a husband and wife and injured five other people, including a teenager, Rostov Governor Yuri Slyusar said.
